claims: March 31 is primarily recognized as Cesar Chavez Day (or Farmworkers Day) in the U.S.
Cesar Chavez Day honors the birth and legacy of Cesar Chavez
March 31 is widely celebrated as the International Transgender Day of Visibility
Cesar Chavez Day celebrates the birthday of Cesar Chavez
Cesar Chavez is an American labor leader and civil rights activist
International Transgender Day of Visibility is dedicated to celebrating transgender people and raising awareness of discrimination
World Backup Day encourages people to back up their data to prevent loss
National Crayon Day celebrates the invention of crayons
National Tater Day is a day to celebrate tater tots and potatoes
National Prom Day is a day to celebrate and remember high school proms
In 2026, some locations in California have renamed Cesar Chavez Day to "Farmworkers Day" or "Farm Workers Appreciation Day"
